# Instructions
#### The Download buttons will take you to the JSON source in GitHub. Download both files from GitHub and then upload into a directory. Launch Visual Studio Code Chat, open the directory where the downloaded json files were saved and enter the following prompt:

#### I created a workflow (workflowexample.workflow.json) by getting DQL from every tile that has DQL in a dashboard (DashboardExample.json) and adding a workflow step to my workflow for each DQL query. The workflow runs each DQL concurrently, then passes the results to Dynatrace Intelligence for analysis. It then will send a summary email. I need you to create me similar workflows for each Dashboard at "[*your directory or repo for your dashboards*]". Make sure to build a DQL workflow step for each DQL based tile and add a timeframe filter for yesterday. If the query does not start with data json:"[]", use "from: @d-1d, to: @d" for the timeframe filter. If the DQL is fetching from user events, make sure to use user.events and not user_events. If the Dashboard has any filters using variables (the field will start with a $), please remove those filters. If the DQL query doesn't have a limit, use limit 25. Other than the above conditions, do not alter the DQL any other way and make sure each DQL tile in the dashboard is added to a DQL task in the workflow. Do note create and DQL task from variables or create new ones. Add [*your email address*]to the to address in the send email step. Make sure all functions used in DQL are correct based on dynatrace official documentation (https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/discover-dynatrace/platform/grail/dynatrace-query-language) and parsing is correct in the DQL based on dynatrace official DPL documentation (https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/discover-dynatrace/platform/grail/dynatrace-pattern-language).
